## Notes

What it is for: the store where secrets live, issuing short-lived credentials to
people and AI agents, plus an SSH CA. Replaces
[security-vault](security-vault.md) (BUSL-1.1). The recommended pairing is
[security-external-secrets](security-external-secrets.md) syncing from it through
[eso-store](security-openbao-eso-store.md); see
[secret strategy](../concepts/secret-strategy.md).

- **Configuration is a script, not a manifest**: `scripts/openbao/bootstrap.sh`
  (kv-v2, auth methods, SSH CA, policies under `policies/`, admins), run once
  after `bao operator init`. Guide: [`docs/apps/openbao.md`](../../docs/apps/openbao.md).
- **Kinds above include the sub-directories'**: the base itself declares the
  StatefulSet, Services, ServiceAccount, ClusterRoleBinding, NetworkPolicy,
  ConfigMap and Ingress. `seal-static`, `raft-snapshot` and `eso-store` are
  Components; `follow-namespace` is a transformer.
- **"Unused in this repo" on the sub-pages is a compiler limit**: consumers are
  counted from `resources:` only. The `openbao-secrets` use case composes all
  four through `components:` and `transformers:`.
- **Namespace**: `security` by default. An overlay's `namespace:` plus
  [follow-namespace](security-openbao-follow-namespace.md) in the same
  kustomization moves everything; `api_addr` / `cluster_addr` are built by the
  pod from its own namespace.
- **NetworkPolicy**: clients outside the namespace need
  `ait.aitizate.com/openbao-access=true` on theirs, or the connection is refused.
- **Proof**: [usecases-openbao-secrets](../overlays/usecases-openbao-secrets.md)
  runs the whole lifecycle in CI (`validate-usecases.yml`).
